decision: Adopt two-level regime model (legal regime + statistical pool group) for Phase 0
rationale: Matrix changes create incompatible pooling groups; schedule/economic changes create legal eras without splitting the statistical series. User-approved design decision.
alternatives_considered: Single-level regime model (rejected: would conflate economic changes with sampling changes)

decision: Reclassify SRC-NY-PB-ARCHIVE and SRC-NY-MM-ARCHIVE (nylottery.org) from Tier-1 official_archive to Tier-3 secondary
rationale: nylottery.org self-identifies as an independent unofficial service not affiliated with or endorsed by the New York State Gaming Commission or New York Lottery. Tier-1/Tier-2 draw-data eligibility requires official operator or government provenance. Artifacts retained immutably for audit; records sourced solely from these may not be analysis_eligible.
alternatives_considered: Delete artifacts (rejected: audit history must be preserved); keep Tier-1 (rejected: misrepresents source authority)
notes: Enforced by pipeline authority gate + verify_phase1 checks; canonical PB/MM history rebuilt on official sources.
